description:
Goal
Restore the native selective-receive continuation contract for fixtures2/behavior/receive_selective_refs.fz.

Baseline proof
A clean detached worktree at integration parent f8a7557a0 reproduces both failures with: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/fz-1ah-parent-target cargo test --test fz2_cli receive_fixtures -- --nocapture. tests/fz2_cli.rs::run_and_interp_execute_receive_fixtures and ::build_executes_receive_fixtures both panic at src/compiler2/native_codegen/terminator.rs:182: continuation callee 32 has 1 logical argument but 2 published param reprs. The fz-1ah.12 worktree reproduces them with: cargo test --test fz2_cli receive_fixtures -- --nocapture, at the corresponding line 161 with telemetry absent. fz-1ah.12 did not introduce the defect. Closed fz-go4.10 intended to fix this surface, so this is a regression follow-up.

Strategy
Reopen the data-model seam behind closed fz-go4.10 rather than weakening the invariant: prove which authority owns the selective-receive outcome closure and its logical delivery arguments, then make continuation param representations consume that authority once.

Acceptance
Both exact CLI tests pass for run, interp, and build; the logical-argument/published-representation invariant remains enforced; no telemetry compensation or fixture exception is introduced.
title: Restore selective-receive continuation delivery contract
